producer_manifest.scope: Static foot/bicycle graph; SDK rejects unsupported rules. No raster, DEM or contour data supplied by this plan.
producer_manifest.attribution: OpenStreetMap contributors; source licensing and attribution remain required.

scope: Real Center-produced static foot graph, node endpoints, zero ascent, cold library caches per query. Counts include package open/graph initialization.
ram_scope: Configured live library workspace/readers/cursor/label/queue/output payload, actual host sizeof; excludes allocator metadata, file adapter, query input and task stack. Not MCU peak.
limitations: Monaco urban network; no DEM/ascent, raster/contour/administration or conditional-rule coverage; desktop filesystem cache affects latency. No board/SD power measurements.
